decision: Use the installed PuriPuly public CLI for ongoing PuriPuly preparation, settings changes, capture start/stop, runtime observations and normal owned-instance lifecycle. This supersedes GUI-only control for PuriPuly, not for other applications.
reason: Native background clicks did not activate the observed controls; the owner reported that the live control confirmation was not visible and explicitly selected official CLI control.
scope: PP1-PP4 only, using the original installed application and existing authorized service routes. Use public commands and revision-guarded settings transactions; do not directly rewrite live settings or patch application sources.
unchanged: D1/D3 continuation only; no replay of completed competitor measurements
Current exact version, safe input and effective state require observation
No new accounts, keys, tiers, payments or model substitutions
No unrelated application or security-policy changes
No scoring/provider-cost work during timed measurement
measurement_gate: This control-method amendment alone is not a source-specific output pass, final C freeze, actual measurement or result.
